assumptions: Published 2026-27 Tandon graduate General tuition, USD 2,626 per credit, multiplied by 30 required credits.
Fall 2027 intake and final rates are not guaranteed; future increases are unknown.
The per-credit general graduate row is distinct from undergraduate flat rates and older Financial Engineering cohort rates.
Living expenses, insurance, mandatory non-tuition charges and any additional prerequisite coursework are excluded. No unconfirmed aid is deducted.

source_excerpt: Graduate Tandon School of Engineering General Fall 2026
fact_summary: The graduate General rows give USD 2,626 per credit in Fall 2026, Spring 2027 and Summer 2027. Thirty verified MSCS credits give USD 78,780 at those rates, before other charges; future prices are not guaranteed.
